title: Class Surface
summary: Shows the public surface of a class: its members and signatures, without the method bodies
intro: Read this when you want to know what a class exposes without reading the whole unit. Class Surface shows its members and signatures, without the method bodies.

steps: Put the caret on the class name in the editor
Choose drag-lint > Inspect Symbol > Class Surface...
The members and signatures are shown without method bodies

pitfalls: names, TYPES and trailing comments. outline --in lists them with line numbers.

questions.ask: What does this class expose, without reading the whole unit?
Which non-public members does it have?
